feature: Court reduction PLUS (POST /v1/plus-apply-reduction-court, hanya update amount_payable tanpa TS-RED)
note: Endpoint terpisah untuk reduction notice di tahap court: validasi amount lalu update amount_payable di VON intranet dan internet saja, tanpa suspension TS-RED dan tanpa record reduced_offence_amount. Tidak dicek terhadap story epic lain di luar chunk ini (OCMS16.6-16.10 hanya menyebut reduction umum).
note_en: A separate endpoint for reducing notices in court stages: it validates the amounts and then updates amount_payable in the intranet and internet VON only, with no TS-RED suspension and no reduced_offence_amount record. Not checked against stories of other epics outside this chunk (OCMS16.6-16.10 only mention reduction in general).

feature: Revert amount_payable saat TS-RED di-revive (memakai nilai pra-reduction di ocms_reduced_offence_amount)
note: Saat suspension TS-RED di-revive, amount_payable dikembalikan ke nilai sebelum reduction dan dilewati kalau notice sudah FP (OCMS-DF-2026-028, OCMS-DF-2026-072). Mungkin masuk story revival di epic lain; tidak dicek terhadap story di luar chunk ini.
note_en: When a TS-RED suspension is revived, amount_payable is restored to the pre-reduction value and skipped if the notice is already FP (OCMS-DF-2026-028, OCMS-DF-2026-072). It may belong to a revival story in another epic; not checked against stories outside this chunk.
